text: Baseline current group sources pass 50 existing tests on both JVM and Scala.js. Independent R lm/metafor FE/DL reference, participant permutation, and sample-block checks pass. Ten additional admission checks fail on each platform, covering a shared rescaling defect, semantic construction/identity failures, and the deliberate but insufficient NaN failure contract. Five native correctness/inference follow-ups have been lodged. Pointwise 20000-study null calibration shows DL/normal alpha inflation (11.60% at alpha=.05 for n=8 and tau2=.2 with known first-level variances). Dense benchmarks completed; OLS/FE/DL at 100x4x200000 give median fit times .358/.961/2.148 seconds and calling-thread allocations 20.8/432/859 MB. Host load is high; report will distinguish exploratory timing from controlled performance evidence. Production group sources remain unchanged.
